$schema_note: Curated 'payload' tags: WHAT each KG supplies, not just how it joins. Each tag is a controlled-vocabulary context type (see 'vocabulary'). Sourced from the registry long descriptions + each KG's curated entity schema (classes/predicates) + its verified crosswalk shared-keys. The value-add types that are NOT join keys (gene_set, trait, pathway, tox_assay, expression, biomarker, variant, ...) are the curated part this file exists to surface. Edit this file (the source of record under metadata/) and run scripts/refresh_snapshot.py to sync the bundled copy.

vocabulary.gene_set: Gene sets, signatures, or inferred gene-trait / gene-factor groupings
vocabulary.variant: Sequence variants - SNPs / SNVs / eQTLs / natural variants
vocabulary.pathway: Pathways and biomolecular / signaling interactions (Reactome / NCI-PID)
vocabulary.biomarker: Biomarkers and their diagnostic / prognostic / predictive roles
vocabulary.tox_assay: Toxicology / bioassay screening results (ToxCast / Tox21 / ICE)
vocabulary.adverse_event: Adverse events and adverse outcome pathways (MAUDE / AOP-Wiki)
vocabulary.aging: Aging, solitude, and behavioral-health research concepts
vocabulary.biology_concept: General biology concepts and causal mechanisms (textbook-derived)
vocabulary.geospatial: Geospatial features / place-based linkage (S2 cells, FIPS, ZIP, admin regions)
vocabulary.hydrology: Hydrologic features (streams, aquifers, water wells, water systems)
vocabulary.environmental: Environmental contamination, samples, and measurements (e.g. PFAS)
vocabulary.climate: Climate models, projections, and natural hazards
vocabulary.justice: Criminal-justice, court, and crime / incident records
vocabulary.software: Software packages, versions, and vulnerabilities (supply chain)
vocabulary.publication: Scientific publications and their links to data
vocabulary.ontology: OBO ontology hierarchies - the cross-graph expansion / bridge backbone
vocabulary.metadata: Dataset-level VoID metadata about the OKN graphs themselves
vocabulary.general: Broad, general-purpose knowledge base spanning many domains
